mapper.select: SELECT wm.member_id "memberId", md.name "name", wm.role "role", md.profile "profilePhoto", wm.workspace_id "workId" FROM workspace_members wm JOIN members m ON m.member_id = wm.member_id JOIN member_details md ON m.member_id = md.member_id WHERE wm.workspace_id = #{workId} AND wm.status = 0 AND m.status = 0 ORDER BY role DESC, name ASC
